judgement.reason: Mail-in-a-Box is a full mail server appliance (SMTP, IMAP, DNS) installed onto a fresh Ubuntu machine, not a single HTTP web app that Deployz can run in a container.

evidence.quote: Mail-in-a-Box turns a fresh Ubuntu 22.04 LTS 64-bit machine into a working mail server by installing and configuring various components.

* SMTP ([postfix](http://www.postfix.org/)), IMAP ([Dovecot](http://dovecot.org/)), CardDAV/CalDAV ([Nextcloud](https://nextcloud.com/)), and Exchange ActiveSync ([z-push](http://z-push.org/)) servers
